# As PO, I would like the application to support feature flagging

As PO, I would like the application to support feature flagging so that we can enable/disable flags.

This ticket is for the lead architect to spend time choosing a feature flagging framework that is flexible enough to allow the business to enable and disable features. This is necessary because, to meet the regulator's constraints, the application has to be a "non-medical" device.

### Done When:
- [ ] feature flagging system / framework chosen
- [ ] CTO approves of the framework
- [ ] framework supports **immediate or near-real-time** disabling/enabling of features per environment
- [ ] _nice to have: supports disabling/enabling of features per instance or tenant_
